examName: Accelerating Sales Pipelines with AI in Dynamics 365
note: Domains and weights follow Microsoft's published skills-measured outline for AB-210. The exam name and the credential name differ, as they do for AB-410 and AB-620: the study guide heading reads 'Accelerating Sales Pipelines with AI in Dynamics 365' while the credential earned is 'Dynamics 365 Sales AI Consultant Associate', which is what catalog.json carries. The guide carries no 'Skills measured as of <date>' line — the seventh undated guide in the catalogue — and the exam is in beta, so the blueprint may move; re-check learn.microsoft.com before sitting it. AB-210 is the 2026 successor to the retired MB-280 and covers Dynamics 365 Sales rather than the Copilot administration the AB Fundamentals describe.
